justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/report/locks/OptimisedLockRowBean.java, OptimisedLockRowBuilder.java, and ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/report/ReportStage.java. The target package has only two classes and only one observed internal importer: ReportStage imports the lock bean/builder and uses them for the ELIDED_LOCK branch (lines 23-24, 85, 156). Its outgoing dependencies are shared base/domain packages (`ui.report.AbstractReportRowBean`/`IReportRowBean`, `report.Report`, `report.ReportType`, `model.Compilation`, JavaFX), so there is no evidence that a stable package depends heavily on less-stable packages.
